Contract Generator.contract:
Contract AutomatedTellerMachineSystem::printReceipt(): Real {
	definition:
		inputCard: BankCard = self.InputCard
	precondition:
		inputCard.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		CardIDValidated = true and
		PasswordValidated = true
	postcondition:
		if IsDeposit = true 
		then result = DepositedNumber 
		else if IsDeposit = false 
		then result = WithdrawedNumber 
		else result = 0 and
		(IsDeposit = true or
		IsDeposit = false or
		result = 0) 
		endif  
		endif 
}
